name: Vertreibt sie
summary: Baine Bloodhoof asks you to drive the Galak centaurs from the village’s path. Their defeat promises the children a measure of safety.

sections.title: The Galak
sections.body: Baine asks you to kill six Galak centaurs and four Galak scouts, then bring him Herak the Plunderer’s head. The village’s safety is at stake.

sections.title: A Village’s Relief
sections.body: Baine hears the last centaur fall and the stampede cease. He calls the day a great victory for the village and says its children need the feeling of safety more than ever.

faq.q: Who asks me to drive off the Galak?
faq.answer: Baine Bloodhoof asks you to confront the Galak centaurs and scouts and bring him Herak the Plunderer’s head.

faq.q: What does Baine want from me?
faq.answer: Baine asks you to kill six Galak centaurs and four Galak scouts, then bring him Herak the Plunderer’s head.
Herak the Plunderer is the Galak whose head Baine asks you to bring.

faq.q: Why does this matter to the village?
faq.answer: Baine says victory brings the village’s children a feeling of safety they need more than ever.

angles.text: As a tauren, Baine calls the bloodshed a unique honor among your people.
